name: Goblins Win!
label: Quest
description: In Thousand Needles, a goblin race ticket pays off when the goblins come out ahead. A prize box comes back to whoever held the winning stub.
intro: In Thousand Needles, a goblin race ticket pays off when the goblins come out ahead. A prize box comes back to whoever held the winning stub.

p: The goblin race ticket is the stub that counts when the goblins win. Hold on to it, and a goblin prize box is yours once the result is in. The gnome ticket has a result of its own, for the other side of the race.
